name: print-social-goodbank-posts-blue-pink-duotone-with-underlined-headlines
title: GoodBank pack with blue-to-magenta duotone portraits, stripe shards and underlined headlines
whatItIs: Nine square posts with a man in a pink suit rendered in blue-magenta duotone, diagonal stripe shards, white and blue panels with bold black headlines ('We Make Banking Easy For You') where a word is underlined, small icon feature rows and pink 'Know more' pills.
whatItMeans: Bold and friendly; the duotone and hot pink make a bank feel youthful and approachable.
techniques: Render photos as a two-colour duotone.
Underline one key word in the headline.
Slice diagonal stripe shards across the background.
Use tiny icon rows for features.

vocabulary.definition: An image in two colours, usually dark and light.
An angled shape filled with diagonal stripes.
